references.text: God comes down to intervene and speak with His people, the same pattern as when God comes down to speak with Moses
Jethro advised Moses to distribute leadership among several men, the same principle of shared leadership and burden
The fulfillment of the promise that the Spirit would be taken from Moses and placed on the seventy elders
Moses' wish that all the Lord's people were prophets and that the Lord would put His Spirit upon them
The Spirit that was on Elijah was transferred to Elisha, a parallel to the transfer of the Spirit from Moses to the elders
The promise that God will pour out His Spirit on His people, a thematic connection to the distribution of the Spirit
The prophecy that God will pour out His Spirit on all flesh, an expanded fulfillment of the distribution of the Spirit
Pentecost, when the Holy Spirit was poured out on the disciples, a New Testament parallel to the distribution of the Spirit on the elders
The apostles chose seven men to help with the service, the same principle of sharing the burden in leadership
Spiritual gifts are distributed among many in the church, a thematic connection to the distribution of the Spirit on the seventy elders
